simple.meaning: שִׁקּוּי (shiqqûwy) is a Hebrew action word meaning “a beverage ; moisture , i.e. (figuratively) refreshment.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 2 times in Proverbs, Hosea, beginning at Proverbs 3:8. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שִׁקּוּי (H8250) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: שִׁקּוּי (shiqqûwy) / H8250 is traced through Proverbs 3:8, Hosea 2:7 with source-language evidence and verse context.
